decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - Each of the new plate glazing panels and the new door hereby approved, shall have two rows of visual manifestation on the glazing panels at two levels, a) between 850mm and 1000mm above ground level, and b) between 1400mm and 1600mm above ground level each in the form of a sign or logo not less than 150mm in diameter and these shall be put in place when the new glazing is installed and permanently retained thereafter.
Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
description: Installation of  a new shop front inline with the exiting shop front
